content:
Lina (CS): quick sync — Arborix renewal. procurement sent a PO but it's unsigned and billing entity is 'Arborix GmbH (DE)'. they want to pay by card instead of wiring the PO. missing: signed PO, VAT certificate, sample invoice with VAT field. tagging @Omar and @Diane.
Omar (Sales): buyer says card is fine if we can provide an invoice sample showing VAT line and their company name. they can also provide company extract PDF. they gave a provisional vendor id 'ARB-EU-99' but finance flagged mismatch vs registry name.
Diane (Legal): for DE entities we need either a delegated signer letter or a signed purchase order pdf. org chart alone won't work for accounting. we can allow a one-time card charge if they sign a short acceptance that they'll submit the signed PO + VAT cert within 14 days. i'll prepare a 1-paragraph addendum.
Kai (Ops): ops needs exact legal name (no abbreviations), billing email, and the bank remit if wiring later. vendor id provisional ok for temp card. also need SOW attached to invoice before seats provisioned.
Lina (CS): paste PO snippet from procurement DM: 
```
PO#: A-2026-33 (unsigned)
Bill To: Arborix GmbH
Seats: 80
Term: 12 months
Total: EUR 24,000
Billing contact: acctspay@arborix.de
Vendor ID: ARB-EU-99 (provisional)
```
Lina (CS): buyer claims VAT-exempt under intra-EU reverse charge. they asked if we need their VAT certificate.
billing-bot: draft invoice INV-3247 created (EUR 24,000)  status: draft, missing SOW attachment. link: https://billing.internal/INV-3247
Omar (Sales): propose card tokenization for onboarding month only. conditions: 1) card charge covers month1 only 2) buyer to deliver signed PO + VAT certificate within 14 days 3) if PO not delivered, we issue credit and revert to PO billing for remaining term but card is non-refundable for month1. needs legal ok.
Diane (Legal): ok with that flow but add clause: "Buyer agrees to deliver signed PO and VAT certificate within 14 calendar days. Failure to deliver allows Seller to withhold seat provisioning for subsequent months." i'll attach that sentence to the addendum.
Kai (Ops): from ops side: once card charge succeeds, we can provision seats immediately but set onboarding in 'pending compliance' state until docs come in. ops will not push production access until SOW is attached.
Lina (CS): action items: Lina -> request VAT cert + company extract + signed PO (ask for PDF). Omar -> escalate to buyer exec if they push back on card. Diane -> draft addendum. Kai -> prepare provisioning flow flag.
Omar (Sales): pinged buyer's finance lead. they replied: "we can upload VAT cert and registration but legal sign-off might take 10 business days".
Lina (CS): made customer-facing reply: "we can run month1 on card if you sign attached addendum and upload VAT cert + signed PO within 14 days. will you confirm?"
Buyer (via DM): "we can do addendum and VAT cert but PO will be slower. can you accept company extract + email from CEO as interim?"
Diane (Legal): company extract + CEO email not sufficient for PO requirement. accept CEO email only as confirmation of intent; still need signed PO or delegation letter.
billing-bot: scheduled: if no signed PO by 2026-07-05T09:00Z, create proforma PRO-3247 for card capture at 09:15Z next day.
Kai (Ops): checklist: [ ] signed PO (pdf) [ ] VAT certificate (pdf) [ ] SOW (pdf) [ ] billing contact confirmed. mark thread when items complete.
Lina (CS): timeline: if we receive addendum + VAT cert by Tue EOD, we proceed with card charge Wed morning. otherwise, hold and escalate.
Omar (Sales): noted. will follow up with buyer exec if we don't see docs by Tue morning.
Lina (CS): thanks all. i'll post the addendum draft when Diane drops it. :thumbsup:
